global: This is spicy ramen with a vibrant red broth, topped with chashu pork and greens. The white bowl, adorned with red characters, sits on a wooden table under warm, ambient lighting.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, smooth grain patterns, and subtle reflections from ambient lighting.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with red Japanese text and tomato motif, smooth glossy surface, slightly curved rim.
regions.soup: The spicy broth is vivid red, glossy, and swirling around golden noodles and dark green spinach leaves.
regions.spoon: A white ceramic spoon with a glossy surface, slightly stained yellow-orange at the tip, has a smooth, curved, elongated shape.
regions.meat: Chashu pork: golden-brown, tender-looking slices with slightly crispy edges and visible fat marbling.
